steps: Cut pork belly into chunks. Blanch in cold water and boil until the outside turns pale.
Rinse the blanched pork, drain well, and pat dry with kitchen paper.
Heat a little oil in a pot. Add ginger and scallion whites; stir-fry until fragrant.
Add pork and pan-fry until lightly golden on the outside.
Add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, cooking wine, and rock sugar. Stir-fry until evenly coated.
Add enough hot water to cover. Bring to a boil, then simmer on low heat for 40 minutes.
Add carrots and simmer for another 20 minutes.
Reduce the sauce to your liking. Plate and garnish with scallion greens.
notes: A home-style red-braised pork belly (hong shao rou) finished with tender carrots.
